GNU Go / wasm-gnugo source reference

UPSTREAM_REPOSITORY=https://github.com/TristanCacqueray/wasm-gnugo.git
UPSTREAM_COMMIT=382df5a9b14b62ea451012ec7d2e81c61162e037

The School of Go interface is a separate project component.
GNU Go is used as an independent game engine through gnugo-worker.js.

For a future custom build, keep all project-specific GNU Go changes and build instructions in this directory.
